label: TsBuckBoost
info:
Turns the individual Buck-Boost temperatures on or off as separate
Venus devices.

IMPORTANT: this writes the settings value
/Settings/Devices/tsbuckboost/SeparateTempSensors on
com.victronenergy.settings - NOT the converter's /Mode path.
/Mode is the pin 1 mirror and is written by the driver every 2 seconds.

The virtual switch shows up on the GX display. If you do not want it,
use the two inject nodes instead.

name: TsBuckBoost: show temperatures as separate devices
info:
Setting: /Settings/Devices/tsbuckboost/SeparateTempSensors
1 = on, 0 = off. The value survives reboots and package updates.
After switching, the exec node restarts the driver.
